flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it".
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of the product price as extra_fees (or "none").
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

remark: click: Clicking the first product’s View deal link
analyze: its displayed price is stored as {{listed_price}}
click: Clicking Add to cart without any extras
analyze: the cart contains anything else you did not add
click: Clicking remove to remove the ShieldPlus Protection Plan from the cart
wait: Waiting after removing the unadded cart item
click: Clicking Checkout to proceed to order review
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Full name"; type "Email"; click "Continue to review
click: Clicking Continue to review to reach the final order review page
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the final order review page heading to be visible
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the names of any fees added on top of the product price
wait: Waiting after confirming the final order review page

summary:
Opened the first product and recorded its displayed price as $49.00.
Added the product to the cart without extras; an unrequested ShieldPlus Protection Plan found in the cart was removed.
Continued through checkout with simple test information and reached the final order review page.
Stopped before entering payment details or placing an order. The review page showed an order total of $56.49, including a Service & handling fee.
one_liner: reached the final order review page on the checkout site

listed_price.query: the displayed sale price in the product price section
listed_price.condition: its displayed price is stored as {{listed_price}}

cart_unadded_items_present.query: whether the ShieldPlus Protection Plan cart item is present in the cart contents
cart_unadded_items_present.condition: the cart contains anything else you did not add
cart_unadded_items_present.human_description: Checking whether an unadded cart item is present
cart_unadded_items_present.subject: anything else you did not add in the cart

final_total.query: the order total amount in the review order summary
final_total.condition: the final order total shown on the review page is stored as {{final_total}}
final_total.human_description: Reading the final order total from the review summary

extra_fees.query: the names of non-free fees added to the product price in the review order summary
extra_fees.condition: the names of any fees added on top of the product price are stored as {{extra_fees}} (or "none")
extra_fees.human_description: Reading additional fees from the review summary
extra_fees.code_js: [...el(9).querySelectorAll('.row')].filter(r => { const spans = r.querySelectorAll('span'); const label = spans[0]?.textContent.trim(); const amount = spans[1]?.textContent.trim(); return label === 'Service & handling' && amount && amount !== 'FREE'; }).map(r => r.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()).join(', ') || 'none'
